text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy took a powerful first step 
along the royal road. Amidst the 
resounding cheers, she begins to speak.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely become a true hero." "I 
will create a hero's tale worthy of the 
stage known as the Nippon Derby"... she 
declared.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I vividly pictured the hero 
being welcomed with thunderous applause. 
And then...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
I firmly believed that it would become 
reality. Next up—the Japanese Derby.
